vocabulary_note: verdict uses the closed T2 vocabulary as a status+diagnosis pair (same shape as the A3/A4/E/E2/E3 artefacts); Phase F is HORS-PROD by gate (no live palier here — the live flip is Phase H), so the palier below is the EMPIRICAL half run on a FRESH copy of the real VPS store, and the hermetic anchors are committed tests that replay on every CI run
scoping_note: per preflight F (PLAN-ADAPT) the Phase-D premise 'blobs.db is an unreadable redb-v2 store' was REFUTED by on-disk bytes: BOTH redb files of the real store are FILE_FORMAT_VERSION3 (redb 2.6.3 already wrote v3); the real incompatibility is the pre-redb-3.0 type tag on variable-width TUPLE tables, which only iroh-docs tables carry. So blobs opens with NO migration and NO pin loss (the discard-vs-shim decision is moot), and docs migrates automatically at open (default redb-v2-migration feature, temp+swap, one-way, backup kept). The boot-order protection is INVERTED (blobs no-op -> a naive boot proceeds to the one-way docs migration): the no-boot-on-real-store rule stays the ONLY guard until Phase H

real_store_copy_migration.criterion: on a FRESH per-run extraction of the gitignored real VPS store tarball (data/vps-store-098/, secrets never committed): (1) FsStore::load opens the DIRTY blobs.db under iroh-blobs 0.103 with zero migration artefacts and untouched payload files; (2) iroh_docs::store::Store::persistent migrates the DIRTY docs.redb (repair + tuple migration together — a path no upstream synthetic test covers), keeps the .backup-redb-v2-tuples sibling, leaves no docs.db.migrate* orphan, and a second open is a plain open; (3) every M8 namespace_id row (sbfb-ideas AND sbfb-feed) still exists in the migrated namespaces-2 table — the boot self-heal recreate arm is never entered; (4) coordinator.db reads back after WAL replay (M8/M18 keep_online/M19 invites+seed_invite); (5) node_key byte-identical (node_id unchanged, Phase H prerequisite); (6) anchors.json locator tickets re-parse as BlobTicket under the current lock; default-author, directory_revision.json (S75 anti-rollback floor), subscriptions.json present
real_store_copy_migration.observed: run 2026-07-06 on the Windows dev machine via nextest (real_vps_store_copy_migrates_and_survives, env-gated on the tarball): blobs open clean + data listing unchanged (3 payload files); docs migrated with backup sibling, 0 temp orphans, idempotent re-open; m8_keys=[sbfb-feed, sbfb-ideas] both found in migrated namespaces-2; keep_online rows=1, invites rows=5, seed_invite rows=0; node_key identical; anchors=1 ticket re-parsed. The test re-extracts the tarball PER RUN (the migration mutates the copy via the swap — a reused tree would silently test a no-op)
real_store_copy_migration.rollback_note: the docs migration is ONE-WAY: rollback = restore the tar snapshot OR rename docs.redb.backup-redb-v2-tuples back over docs.redb; disk cost ~2x during the migration (temp file + backup); Linux caveat: a retry can rename(2)-clobber a pre-existing backup

hermetic_anchors.docs_migration: store_migration::docs_store_with_legacy_tuple_tags_migrates_on_open — forges a legacy tuple-tag docs store IN-PROCESS via the redb_v3 dev-dep (same 3.1.3 already in the lock, zero lock delta, NEVER a redb-2.6.3 dev-dep which would collide with the Phase G deny.toml flip; upstream model iroh-docs fs.rs test_migration_redb_v2_tuples), proves redb4 rejects it with TableTypeMismatch, Store::persistent migrates it, the backup sibling appears, and all four tables (records-1, latest-by-author-1, records-by-key-1, namespaces-2) survive byte-exact
hermetic_anchors.blobs_round_trip: store_migration::fresh_blobs_store_round_trips_across_reload — a fresh iroh-blobs 0.103 fs store round-trips bytes across a reload with zero backup/migrate artefacts (pins the schema the real-store gate relies on)
hermetic_anchors.recreate_guard: runtime::tests::boot_storage_namespace_refuses_recreate_on_interrupted_migration + boot_feed_namespace_refuses_recreate_on_interrupted_migration — the crash-window residual (rename->persist crash leaves docs.redb ABSENT, next boot creates a fresh empty store, every M8 replica then reads as a legitimate 'Replica not found' NOT caught by the A2 fail-loud): both boot boundaries now REFUSE the silent recreate while the migration backup sibling exists, with a diagnosable restore message; M8 rows stay untouched on refusal

residual_risk: the crash-window guard closes the silent-loss path only when the backup sibling survived the crash (it does, by construction: the backup rename happens FIRST); tar snapshots before any real migration remain mandatory (Phase B: Win taken, Mac PENDING — no Mac boot before its snapshot); migration artefacts (backup with old NamespaceSecret, migrate temp) are secrets-bearing and not covered by *.redb/*.db gitignore patterns outside data/ — fixture leak line routed to Phase G THREAT_MODEL (T-STORE-FIXTURE-LEAK) together with T-STORE-MIGRATION-CRASHWINDOW and the C4/C5 kickoff correction (the redb-v2-migration feature EXISTS and is default; never set default-features=false on iroh-docs)
